smoke.interpretation: Both arms exercised the real provider, baseline evaluator, database, and resume path. Both had 2/2 patch failures, so the smoke did not observe a proposal evaluator call.

arm_comparison.time_to_first_improvement: No event in either arm; all runs right-censored.
arm_comparison.resume_consistency: No proposal artifact delta in either arm; neither arm was database-row idempotent on reopen.

pre_frozen_gate.bootstrap_note: All ten baseline-only paired deltas are exactly zero; every paired resample is therefore zero.

metric_interpretation.best_so_far_auc: baseline-only in every declared generation slot
metric_interpretation.evaluator_calls_per_proposal: 0/34 in each arm; baseline calls excluded
metric_interpretation.observed_token_usage: Exact final token_count event from each of 68 Codex rollout JSONL files; reasoning_output_tokens is a subset of output_tokens.
metric_interpretation.patch_type_selection: All 68 realized proposals selected diff under the fixed per-process Python/NumPy seed; the configured diff/full probabilities remained 0.5/0.5.
metric_interpretation.resume_consistency: 20/20 added no proposal artifacts; 0/20 were row-idempotent because reopen inserted a duplicate baseline program/archive row.

invalid_attempt_audit.reason: The first driver used the declared target of 6 for a resume check after the Native main process stopped early at generation 3. That resume invocation created generation 4 and began a new Codex proposal, violating the no-failure-resampling rule.
invalid_attempt_audit.response: The process group was interrupted immediately, the entire attempted matched block was excluded, all artifacts were preserved here, and the driver was changed so a resume probe targets max_observed_generation_index_plus_one and therefore cannot add a proposal generation.
invalid_attempt_audit.recovery_policy: Restart all 10 matched blocks in a fresh formal directory; do not reuse either arm from the invalid block.
